statements.statement: CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was ordered for the patient

Patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are concerning for an underlying arrhythmia
The monitoring study is required to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The service addresses a distinct diagnostic question documented in the clinical indication note
The service should not be treated as bundled and non-payable under CO-97
